sloka: तत्र न्यस्तानि माम्सानि पान भूमौ ददर्श सः ।रौक्मेषु च विशलेषु भाजनेष्व् अर्ध भक्षितान् ॥५-११-१२॥
transliteration: tatra nyastāni māmsāni pāna bhūmau dadarśa saḥ ।raukmeṣu ca viśaleṣu bhājaneṣv ardha bhakṣitān ॥5-11-12॥

translations.english: The tiger among vanaras also saw there meat of peacocks and chicken placed in large golden vessels, some half eaten.
